page: Microsoft Azure M256lds_v4 is a high-capacity, memory-optimized instance from the MDSMediumMemoryv4 family, running under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The virtual machine is built on the x86_64 Intel processor architecture, delivering 256 dedicated vCPUs combined with 3,892.0 GB of system memory, which provides approximately 15.2 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware configuration includes 9,448 GB of local NVMe SSD storage along with Premium Storage capability, while containing zero discrete GPUs and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The inclusion of a 9,448 GB local NVMe SSD volume offers substantial low-latency temporary capacity directly attached to the host, facilitating intensive I/O operations without depending solely on remote network disks. With fully dedicated vCPU allocation, compute operations run without the multi-tenant resource sharing typical of smaller tiers. However, operational architecture must accommodate the ephemeral nature of local NVMe storage and the absence of bundled public networking, requiring appropriate auxiliary configurations for persistence and routing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the M256lds_v4 delivers extreme resource density within a single node, mitigating the network latency, operational overhead, and synchronization complexity required by clustered multi-node configurations. The hardware profile is engineered for memory-bound, demanding deployments such as large-scale in-memory databases, SAP HANA, extensive relational database servers, enterprise extract-transform-load (ETL) processing, and real-time big data analytics.
description: Microsoft Azure M256lds_v4 is a high-capacity memory-optimized virtual machine designed for resource-intensive enterprise workloads. Built on the x86_64 Intel processor architecture and running under Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance features 256 dedicated vCPUs and 3,892.0 GB of RAM, yielding roughly 15.2 GB of memory per core. Local storage is provided through a high-capacity 9,448 GB NVMe SSD array, supporting high-throughput scratch disks and tempdb storage, complemented by Premium Storage support. The server contains zero discrete GPUs and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. By consolidating extensive compute and memory resources into a single system, the instance minimizes distributed node complexity. M256lds_v4 is positioned for massive in-memory databases, SAP HANA environments, heavy relational database servers, real-time analytics, and enterprise data warehousing workloads requiring substantial memory density alongside high-capacity local solid-state storage.
